Manual CLI smoke test was blocked in this sandbox (no approval surface here), so I relied on the automated test suite, which passed. I'll skip further shell exploration attempts here.

## Summary

`habit done` now accepts an optional trailing date argument:

- `src/streak.js`: added `resolveDate(when)` — accepts a `Date`, `'today'`, `'yesterday'`, or a `YYYY-MM-DD` string; throws on anything else.
- `src/commands.js`: `done(name, when)` now resolves `when` via `resolveDate` and returns the error message if the date is invalid.
- `src/cli.js`: pops a trailing date-shaped token (`today`/`yesterday`/`YYYY-MM-DD`) off the CLI args before joining the rest as the habit name, so `habit done read yesterday` and `habit done read 2026-09-01` work, while multi-word habit names without a trailing date are unaffected.
- Added tests in `test/commands.test.js` for explicit dates, `yesterday`, and invalid input.

All 10 tests pass (`npm test`).
